abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine whether gray scale characteristics of the solid components of cystic ovarian teratomas exist that could differentiate more common benign forms from malignant variants. METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed the sonographic images of 188 ovarian teratomas that contain at least a 25% cystic component and correlated the images with the final diagnosis. Features of the solid component assessed included its echo texture, overall appearance, shape, size, and internal homogeneity. RESULTS: One-hundred seventy-seven teratomas were benign, and 11 were malignant; among the malignant masses, 7 were high grade. Of the benign forms, 155 solid components (88%) were hyperechoic, 168 (95%) were focal in appearance, 105 (59%) were nodular in shape, and 123 (69%) were uniformly solid. Of the malignant types, 9 solid components (82%) were isoechoic, 6 (55%) had branching, 6 (55%) were irregular in shape, and 8 (73%) were uniformly solid. Five malignant teratomas (45% overall and 71% of high-grade subtypes) had branching isoechoic components. Only 2 benign teratomas (1%) had isoechoic components that branched. CONCLUSIONS: The presence of a branching isoechoic component in a cystic ovarian teratoma may suggest malignancy.
abstract_ja: 目的：嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の充実成分のグレースケール所見により、より一般的な良性型と悪性型を鑑別できるかを明らかにすること。方法：嚢胞成分が少なくとも25%の卵巣奇形腫188例の超音波画像を後方視的に検討し、最終診断と対比した。充実成分の評価項目は、エコーテクスチャ、全体的な外観、形状、大きさ、内部の均一性とした。結果：177例が良性、11例が悪性であり、悪性例のうち7例が高悪性度であった。良性例では、充実成分の155例（88%）が高エコー、168例（95%）が限局性、105例（59%）が結節状、123例（69%）が均一な充実性であった。悪性例では、9例の充実成分（82%）が等エコー、6例（55%）が分岐状、6例（55%）が不整形、8例（73%）が均一な充実性であった。悪性奇形腫5例（全体の45%、高悪性度亜型の71%）が分岐する等エコー成分を有していた。分岐する等エコー成分を有していた良性奇形腫はわずか2例（1%）であった。結論：嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫において分岐する等エコー成分が認められる場合、悪性を示唆する可能性がある。
